solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Engineered space unit, life-supporting primarily (7)

indicatorNotes.Engineered: something engineered has been built, its parts arranged into a new shape
indicatorNotes.primarily: take only the first, primary letter of each word

blocks.note: first letters of unit and life

annotation.surface: A description of a spacecraft module built to keep astronauts alive.
annotation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: a capsule really is an engineered space unit that supports life.
annotation.definitionFit: A space capsule is the crewed compartment of a spacecraft, built to sustain life.

entries.clue: Reporter right in centre directed around body of water (13)

indicatorNotes.in: R goes in the word for centre
indicatorNotes.around: the word for directed goes around the water

blocks.note: a pond is a small body of water

annotation.surface: Someone describing a journalist steering a boat round a lake.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Directed' reads as steering, but it means sent, as a letter is sent; the reporter here is one who files stories from abroad.
annotation.definitionFit: A correspondent is a journalist reporting on a subject or from a place.

entries.clue: Old man drinking fruity drink recalled spicy stuff (7)

indicatorNotes.drinking: the old man takes the drink inside him
indicatorNotes.recalled: called back, so the drink's letters run backwards

blocks.note: kir is white wine with blackcurrant liqueur

annotation.surface: An old man sips a fruit cocktail and remembers something spicy.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Recalled' looks like memory, but it turns the drink round, and the old man wraps around it.
annotation.definitionFit: Paprika is a spice ground from dried red peppers.

entries.clue: Free coverage for family members cancelled (5)

indicatorNotes.coverage for: the covering of the word, its outer letters

blocks.note: aunties are family members; drop the outer A and S

annotation.surface: An insurance notice saying free cover for relatives has been withdrawn.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface reads like an insurance policy; 'coverage' actually points at the outside letters of AUNTIES, which are stripped off.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: undoing the knots sets something free.

entries.clue: Gee up shy setter climbing above lair (8)

indicatorNotes.climbing: in a down clue, climbing means reading upwards, so reversed
indicatorNotes.above: in a down clue, this part sits on top of the next

blocks.note: to shy is to throw, to lob
the setter refers to themself as ME
a den is an animal's lair

annotation.surface: Coaxing a timid crossword setter up out of hiding.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Shy' looks like an adjective for the setter, but it is the verb meaning throw. LOB ME climbs to EMBOL, then DEN goes underneath.
annotation.definitionFit: Gee up is an informal British idiom for encouraging someone, making them bolder.

entries.clue: Female bearing pressure on field (6)

indicatorNotes.bearing: the female carries the pressure inside
indicatorNotes.on: RE here is the word 'on', as in 'regarding', added after

annotation.surface: A woman putting pressure on in a field of work.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Field' looks like a meadow; it is a field of work. RE for 'on' is the memo-heading 'regarding'.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym in the sense of an area of activity, as in 'her sphere of influence'.

entries.clue: Shade son instead of Victor in capital (6)

blocks.note: V is Victor in the phonetic alphabet
capital of Austria; swap V for S

annotation.surface: A royal succession note: the son takes over from Victor in the capital.
annotation.walkthrough: Put S in place of the V of VIENNA.
annotation.definitionFit: Sienna is an earthy yellow-brown or red-brown colour.

entries.clue: Representative’s greeting within Rush County (9)

indicatorNotes.within: the first part goes inside the word for rush

blocks.note: MP = Member of Parliament, a representative; 's adds S

annotation.surface: A politician waving hello while dashing round a US county.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Rush County' looks like a place name, but Rush is a verb here. Hampshire is a county on England's south coast.
annotation.definitionFit: Hampshire is an English county on the south coast.

entries.clue: Rubbish dig under French road reported (7)

indicatorNotes.under: in a down clue, the dig sits below the road
indicatorNotes.reported: what is reported is said, so the word is heard, not spelt

blocks.note: rue is French for street; RHU is said the same way
a dig is a cutting remark, a barb

annotation.surface: A news item about rubbish being dug up under a French road.
annotation.walkthrough: RHUBARB is British slang for nonsense. The spelling RHU comes only from the answer; the sound is RUE.
annotation.definitionFit: Rhubarb is British slang for nonsense, rubbish talk.

entries.clue: Upright engineers sited before contractor left base (9)

indicatorNotes.before: the first pieces come ahead of the rest

blocks.note: an ab is an abdominal muscle, which contracts
e is the base of natural logarithms

annotation.surface: Building-site talk: engineers set up before the contractor left the base.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Contractor' reads as a builder; here it is a muscle, which contracts. E as a base comes from maths, the base of natural logs.
annotation.definitionFit: Upright in the moral sense: someone honest has a good reputation.

entries.clue: Bullets periodically hidden behind second shed (5)

indicatorNotes.behind: these letters come after the second

blocks.note: a mo is a moment, a second

annotation.surface: Ammunition stashed at intervals behind a garden shed.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Shed' looks like the garden building; it is the verb. MO for a second is British informal, as in 'half a mo'.
annotation.definitionFit: To moult is to shed feathers, hair or skin.

entries.clue: Nurse certainly stops cycling over buried valuables? (8,5)

indicatorNotes.stops: the word for certainly plugs the gap inside the word for nurse
indicatorNotes.cycling: the letters of OVER cycle round, last letter to the front

blocks.note: OVER with the R cycled to the front

annotation.surface: A nurse on a bike halting over a buried hoard.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Cycling' suggests bikes; it tells you to rotate OVER into ROVE. The question mark is because not all treasure trove is buried.
annotation.definitionFit: Treasure trove is valuables found hidden, often buried, with no known owner.

entries.clue: Spain introducing low-calorie cream (5)

indicatorNotes.introducing: Spain's letter comes first, introducing the rest

blocks.note: E is the international vehicle code for Spain
lite = low-calorie, as on food labels

annotation.surface: Spain launching a low-fat cream product.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Cream' looks like dairy next to low-calorie; it means the best people.
annotation.definitionFit: Cream rises to the top of milk, so the cream of a group is its choicest members.

entries.clue: Picture youngsters being drilled by new head (9)

indicatorNotes.being drilled by: N bores into the word for youngsters
indicatorNotes.head: CAPE, a headland, follows

annotation.surface: A photo of children drilled on parade by a new headteacher.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Head' looks like a headteacher; it is a headland, CAPE.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: one kind of picture is a painting of countryside scenery.

entries.clue: In a fluster after Penny delivered waffle (8)

indicatorNotes.after: the fluster word comes after P

annotation.surface: Someone flustered after Penny brought round the waffles.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Waffle' looks like breakfast delivered by Penny; it is empty talk, and 'delivered' is the speaking.
annotation.definitionFit: To prattle is to talk on foolishly, to deliver waffle.

entries.clue: Note area with lowest repositioned dryers (3,6)

indicatorNotes.repositioned: the letters of lowest are put in new positions

blocks.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale

annotation.surface: A memo about moving the dryers to the lowest area.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Dryers' suggests machines; a tea towel dries dishes. Tea towels are dish cloths.
annotation.definitionFit: Tea towels are cloths for drying dishes, so dryers.

entries.clue: A single megabyte compressed by students in Cloud (6)

blocks.note: NUS = National Union of Students, the UK student body

annotation.surface: A computing note about compressing a megabyte file into cloud storage.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is all computing, so 'Cloud' looks like online storage; it is a weather cloud.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: the grey, rain-bearing kind of cloud has this Latin name.

entries.clue: Fixes spinning top with novel bit of string (8)

indicatorNotes.spinning: turned round, so the letters run backwards
indicatorNotes.bit of: only a bit, the first letter, is taken

annotation.surface: Repairs to a spinning top using a length of string.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Fixes' looks like repairs; here it means tight spots. 'Top' is not the toy but a lid.
annotation.definitionFit: A fix is an awkward predicament, a dilemma.

entries.clue: Workers maybe sip this back inside bar at centre (6)

indicatorNotes.back: going back, the letters are read from right to left
indicatorNotes.inside: the answer lies inside the next words

annotation.surface: Staff sipping a drink back at the bar in the town centre.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Workers' are worker bees, and the definition is a whole phrase describing the answer.
annotation.definitionFit: Worker bees drink nectar from flowers.

entries.clue: Ace struggling with hard word in party game (7)

annotation.surface: A card player finding a tricky word in a party game.
annotation.walkthrough: In the game charades, each word acted out is a charade.
annotation.definitionFit: A charade is one mimed word or phrase in the game of charades.

entries.clue: Energy stored by complex SLR cine device on arm? (8)

indicatorNotes.stored by: E is kept inside the mixed letters
indicatorNotes.complex: the letters are put into a complicated new order

annotation.surface: Camera kit: an SLR and a cine camera, stored in a device on a strap.
annotation.walkthrough: SLR and cine are camera types, so the surface is photography; the arm is a firearm, hence the question mark.
annotation.definitionFit: A silencer fits on the barrel of a firearm to muffle it.

entries.clue: Actors went ahead and performed a two-piece movement (7)

blocks.note: the cast of a play is its actors

annotation.surface: Actors striding ahead to perform a two-part dance.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is theatre, but the movement is chess: castling moves king and rook together.
annotation.definitionFit: Castling is the chess move where king and rook move in a single turn.

entries.clue: Go below group almost supporting framework (6)

indicatorNotes.below: in a down clue, TRY sits under the group word
indicatorNotes.almost: the group word loses its last letter

blocks.note: a go is an attempt, a try

annotation.surface: An instruction to crawl under a band's stage rig.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Go' looks like a verb of movement; it is the noun, a try.
annotation.definitionFit: A gantry is a bridge-like framework supporting cranes, signals or equipment.

entries.clue: Detailed talk led by a retired acting Christian (9)

indicatorNotes.led by: the actor's name comes in front of the talk

annotation.surface: A long speech given by a retired Christian actor.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Christian' looks like religion; it is Christian Bale, the actor, whose surname runs backwards.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a plan worked out in detail is intricate and full.

entries.clue: Message island blocks in advance (5)

indicatorNotes.blocks: the island letter sits inside the message word, blocking it

blocks.note: a post is an online message

annotation.surface: An island ordering its messages ahead of time.
annotation.walkthrough: 'In advance' reads as a phrase meaning beforehand; the definition is only 'advance', in the sense of putting forward an idea.
annotation.definitionFit: Advance in the sense of putting forward a theory for others to consider.

entries.clue: Bread roll on summit? (5)

indicatorNotes.roll: roll it over, so the letters run backwards

annotation.surface: A bread roll eaten at the top of a hill.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Bread roll' looks like one thing; 'roll' is the reversal instruction and 'Bread' alone is the definition.
annotation.definitionFit: Pitta is a flat Middle Eastern bread.

entries.clue: Exchange twisted arrow back in store (5)

indicatorNotes.twisted: turned right round, so the arrow runs backwards
indicatorNotes.back in: the letter at the back of the next word

blocks.note: a dart is a small arrow

annotation.surface: Returning a bent arrow to the shop for an exchange.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface is a shop returns counter; 'twisted' turns DART round and 'back in' takes only the last letter of store.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: swapping goods for goods or money.

entries.clue: Old woman by cash register cutting overly small fruit (9)

indicatorNotes.cutting: the pieces cut into the word for overly

blocks.note: a till is a cash register

annotation.surface: An old woman at the till cutting up fruit that is too small.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Overly small' looks like one phrase; 'overly' is TOO and 'small fruit' is the definition. A tomatillo is a Mexican husk tomato.
annotation.definitionFit: The tomatillo is a small green fruit in a papery husk, used in salsas.

entries.clue: Spotted maiden clearly leaving Italy (6)

blocks.note: M = maiden, an over with no runs in cricket

annotation.surface: A young woman clearly seen as she leaves Italy.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Spotted' looks like 'seen'; it means covered in spots, as with measles, the original sense of measly.
annotation.definitionFit: Measly originally meant spotted with measles.

entries.clue: Butcher’s cut constricting with bandage (7)

indicatorNotes.constricting: the cut of meat squeezes round W

blocks.note: a saddle of lamb is a butcher's joint

annotation.surface: A butcher binding a joint of meat tightly.
annotation.walkthrough: S(W)ADDLE: saddle is a joint, the back of the animal across both loins.
annotation.definitionFit: To swaddle is to wrap tightly in cloth, to bandage.
